body: I posted a field-by-field exact-b33 pre-review map on the bead. No docs path touched. The two easy overclaims to avoid are: embedded supportBasis authenticates execution (it does not; expectedSupportBasis is independently supplied), and share/reason are serialized inputs (share is absent and derived; Unestablished reason is serialized but recomputed and must match). I will review the immutable candidate for exact source agreement when registered.
